reviews.review_title: Return
reviews.review_text:
Hello,

I recently returned several items from order GSO17V581001VTY, and I’m disputing the “Restoration Fees for Defective Products” applied to three of them:

	1.	1 Pair Women’s Fashion Wraparound Glasses (Y2K Music Festival, Black) – price £1.73, deducted £1.56
	2.	Denimoi Bodycon Halter Top (White, 16/XL) – price £6.43, deducted £5.79
	3.	Denimoi Fitted Hollow Eyelet Decor Lace-Up Sleeveless Top (Black, 12/14 L) – price £7.57, deducted £6.81

In total, £14.16 was deducted from my refund of £89.82. These three items were returned unused, unworn, and undamaged. I do not accept that they were “defective” or failed to meet return requirements, and no evidence has been provided to support these deductions.

I am formally requesting:

	•	Clear, itemised photographic evidence showing the specific defect, stain, or damage found on each of these three items
	•	A written explanation of exactly what condition issue was identified for each item
	•	A full reversal of the £14.16 in restoration fees if no valid evidence is provided

I also want to point out an inconsistency: your own Return Policy (Section 8) states that if an item is entirely non-resalable, no refund will be issued at all. In my case, only a small partial amount was refunded on each of these three items, with almost the full value deducted. By your own policy’s logic, this means you have effectively already classified these items as non-resalable — yet you have kept the majority of my money instead of applying the policy correctly, which would mean either a full refund (if resalable) or £0 refund with the item returned to me (if non-resalable). Issuing a near-total deduction while keeping a small partial refund does not match either outcome described in your policy.

Per your own Return Policy, if an item is deemed non-resalable, it is disposed of “unless you instruct us otherwise and agree to pay the cost of its return.” I am formally instructing you not to dispose of these three items. If you are unable to issue a full refund, I request they be returned to me, and I am willing to cover the return shipping cost as per this policy.

However, I want to be clear: since these items were never damaged or used, my primary request remains a full refund. The “return to me” request is a fallback only if you continue to insist these items are non-resalable.

Please note that a fourth item in the same return (Denimoi Zebra Print Top) had £0.00 deducted, which confirms your team is able to assess items fairly when no issue exists — I expect the same standard applied here.

If I do not receive photographic evidence and a satisfactory explanation within a reasonable timeframe, I will escalate this dispute through my card issuer (Visa) as an unauthorised/incorrect deduction, and if necessary to Trading Standards / Citizens Advice.


This is theft, robbery…
Cause why? I would advice anyone reading this not to purchase anything from Shein
Thieves

Order number: GSO17V581001VTY

I look forward to your prompt response with the requested evidence.

reviews.review_title: SHEIN replied to my Trustpilot review…
reviews.review_text:
SHEIN replied to my Trustpilot review saying they needed 24 hours to investigate and asked me to check the app for the resolution.

I did exactly that. The “resolution” in the app was simply that their internal investigation concluded that all the missing items were packed and shipped correctly, so they refused to take responsibility and told me to check the package again or contact the courier.

This is completely unacceptable.

Five items were NOT inside the package when I opened it. They did not fall out, they were not misplaced, and I have already checked everything multiple times.

Instead of providing evidence or offering a real solution, SHEIN simply repeated that their warehouse says everything was shipped, which does not prove that I actually received those items.

So please don’t tell me this case is “being resolved.” It has already been answered, and the answer was to deny my claim without solving anything.

I have already opened a dispute with my bank for the missing items and I will also file a complaint with the consumer protection authorities. I will continue updating this review until this issue is resolved properly.

This has been one of the worst customer service experiences I’ve ever had. Buyers should know that if items are missing from their package, SHEIN may simply claim that everything was shipped and leave you without a refund or replacement.
